ex.en: 5000 yuan is a lot of money.

ex.en: Yugoslavia was a country in southeastern Europe.
ex.zh: 南斯拉夫曾是東南歐的一個國家。

ex.en: Yugoslavia no longer exists as one country.
ex.zh: 南斯拉夫已不再是單一國家。

ex.en: The museum has a Yugoslav flag from the 1980s.
ex.zh: 這間博物館收藏了一面一九八〇年代的南斯拉夫國旗。

ex.en: Many Yugoslav films were shown at the festival.
ex.zh: 影展上放映了許多南斯拉夫電影。
